summary.name: RawTherapee
summary.one_liner: RawTherapee is a free, open-source, cross-platform program for developing raw photo files from many digital cameras.
use_cases: developing raw files from digital cameras
applying flat field and dark frame correction
summary.what_it_does: RawTherapee is a raw photo processing system released as Free Software under GPLv3. It develops raw files from a broad range of digital cameras. It offers non-destructive, 32-bit floating point processing with modern demosaicing algorithms, and can use two demosaicing algorithms on one image. It composites pixel-shift raw files with automatic ghost masking and supports multiple-frame raw files, dark frame subtraction, flat field correction, and hot/dead pixel correction. The page says it is available in over 15 languages.
notable: Free and open source under copyleft GPLv3, source code available on GitHub
Pixel-shift compositing with automatic ghost masking
caveats: Page says it benefits users who take time to learn it, implying a learning curve
Copyleft GPLv3 license governs redistribution and modification
